rule_sets.summary: Decouple compilation/debug/native/Golden local builds from independently verified canonical Library release promotion; never block compiler on missing release credentials.

sensitive_material_policy: fail-closed prepublication scan across release/evidence/diagnostic/support artifacts; secrets and user-specific sensitive material excluded/redacted
third_party_dependency_policy: tracked vendored dependencies are periodically/release-prep reviewed; newer upstream stable releases are surfaced to user with technical recommendation; any dependency source/version update requires explicit user approval

clean_extract_replay.invocation: FINAL_RELEASE G2 and G4; HOTFIX/RC/EXPERIMENTAL only G4; IDS/source-state never as full shard replay. At each required invocation use one clean extraction and shards 0..7.

source_qa.invocation: ONLY per release class and G gate in governance_first_protocol.qa_execution_schedule; passing required 8/8 at an unauthorized stage is not a substitute for prescribed later stage.
